newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Scientific says gets third complaint.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Scientific says gets third complaint.

text.p: Pacific Scientific Co said on Monday it has received a draft complaint from the prior shareholders of Met One Inc, accusing the company of making false and misleading statements regarding itself and its Solium subsidiary.
Pacific Scientific merged with Met One through an exchange of stock in December 1995.
Pacific Scientific said the complaint names it, its chief executive Edgar Brower and its chief financial officer Richard Plat as defendants.
This draft complaint is similar to two previously announced class-action complaints filed in the United States District Court, the company said.

It added that it and its officers deny the allegations in the draft complaint and intend to vigorously defend this action. Correspondence provided with the draft indicates that it might be filed as early as December 5, 1996, in the Superior Court of the State of California, the company said.
The complaint seeks damages based on several causes of action.
